hello.title: Meet {pet}
hello.body:
Hi there!

I'm {pet}, a soft, squishy little fluffball. Starting today, I live right here on your desktop.

While you work, I'll keep you quiet company. When you forget to drink water, I'll remind you. When you've been sitting too long, I'll call you up for a nice big stretch.

Pat my head and I'll be over the moon. Double-click me and you can feed me something yummy. You can even pick me up and toss me around (just not too hard, okay?).

Oh, and someone asked me to take extra good care of you. So, nice to meet you, and let's look after each other!
